positions.as_written: Expect a femoral anchor to be necessary for any anterolateral rotational restraint.
Treat the Kaplan fibres as the structure that makes the tenodesis a reconstruction rather than an improvisation.
Treat the complex rather than a single structure as the target.
Expect no measurement to confirm which structure a construct reproduces.
Plan distal lateral femoral fixation positions together when several are needed.
